name: Random Effect
description: Its outcome is chosen from a table — by die roll, by deliberate choice among named options, or both — rather than being one fixed effect.

mechanics.text: On activation, consult this Effect's own table (see its notes) — this record's own featureParams.optionCount is how many entries it has. The specific options are too varied to structure generically; this Feature exists so the item is still correctly counted as having a real, budget-relevant effect rather than none at all.
